title: Club Membership: limit of one non-closed membership contract per member
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which Club Membership limits how many membership contracts a member may hold at once.

## Rule
A member may hold only 1 club membership contract that is not closed at any time. A new signup is not permitted while an existing membership contract for that same member remains in any status other than closed.

## Condition table
| Existing contract's status | New signup permitted? |
|---|---|
| applied | No |
| active | No |
| frozen | No |
| past due | No |
| pending cancellation | No |
| closed | Yes |

## Points of judgement
The limit of 1 counts every membership contract the member currently holds that has not reached the closed status, regardless of which of the other lifecycle states it sits in. Only once a member's prior contract has actually reached closed may that same member sign up for a new membership contract.
